skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes for 120% ATK Direct DMG. Grants same-column allies [Specialized Speed Up] for 1 round. Removes 1 Energy from the enemy (up to once per round; after a successful removal, the enemy cannot be inflicted with [Fear] in the same round).[Specialized Speed Up]: increases SPD up to 90% of Flashy Flash's SPD.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Upgrades the Ultimate — DMG 120% → 150% ATK; [Specialized Speed Up] raises the same-column ally's SPD to 90% → 95% of Flashy Flash's SPD; removes 1 → 3 Energy from the enemy.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, grants self [Specialized Speed Up] (+5% SPD). If the main target's SPD is lower than Flashy Flash's, deals 300% ATK Extra DMG. After any character acts, removes the enemy's [Basic Acceleration].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, grants self [Specialized Speed Up] (+20% SPD). If the main target's SPD is lower than Flashy Flash's, deals 300% ATK Extra DMG. After any character acts, removes the enemy's [Basic Acceleration].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, grants self [Specialized Speed Up] (+25% SPD). If the main target's SPD is lower than Flashy Flash's, deals 300% ATK Extra DMG. After any character acts, removes the enemy's [Basic Acceleration].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Flashy Flash has a 70% chance and ally in the same column has a 50% chance to trigger [Evade] (Reduce direct/extra/charge/berserk DMG to 1 DMG). After any character acts, if Flashy Flash triggers [Evade], deals 400% ATK as Extra DMG to 1 random enemy which is not in any [Unyielding] state and restores HP by 150% ATK (3 [4] times per round).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Ally in the same column has a 50% chance to trigger [Evade]; on an [Evade], restores HP by 150% ATK, up to 4 times per round.

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Debuff applies to all enemies when their Energy is reduced, blocking or destroying their Energy, making them unable to use their ultimate.
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
Speed ​​buff that while in effect allows the bearer and up to 6 allies to act against and overcome enemies with lower speed.
Removes existing effects/buffs on all enemies.
